meta.title: Double‑click on "Master QCS" does not duplicate ranking view
gaps: Direct assertion that no duplicate ranking panels exist beyond verifying a single Master QCS tab and one QCS ranking grid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Exact rapid double-click timing.; Direct assertion that no duplicate ranking panels exist beyond verifying a single Master QCS tab and one QCS ranking grid.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with an existing bid directly on Master QCS.
Perform the first activation of the Master QCS tab.
Perform the second immediate activation to approximate the requested double-click.
Verify that navigation remains on a single ready Master QCS view.
Verify that only one Master QCS tab is rendered.
Verify that the ranking grid contains the single real vendor column expected from the prepared state.
Verify that the bid ranking data is present and correctly ranked.
Verify that the displayed rate, line amount, and total remain arithmetically correct.
Verify that the QCS view has no duplicate-render artifacts, crash, server error, or raw invalid values.
